infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Community shows your photos and videos so you can choose what to share in posts, stories, messages and your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Community uses your camera so you can take photos and videos to share, make video calls and broadcast live.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Community uses your microphone for voice and video calls, live broadcasts, and when you record a video with sound or a voice message.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Community saves a picture to your library when you tap Save, on a photo in a chat or on a verse card you made.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Community uses your location to show churches and events near you, to pin a place on an event or a note when you ask, and, only when you turn them on, to show your friends where you are or to show you to people nearby.
